caption: The drawing depicts a garment that resembles a long coat or cloak with an over-cape, shown from the front. The garment is primarily light gray in color and features prominent red trim. The red trim appears along the edges of the collar, the vertical opening of the coat, the borders of the cape, the cuffs, and around the bottom hem, where it is also bordered by thin white or light-colored lines. The red trim includes parallel lines and a checked or patterned texture. The coat has visible buttons down the front that are also colored red. The sleeve on the right side of the image is partially visible, showing a cuff with matching red and white decoration. The overall shape of the garment is flared and circular, with the cape-like layer covering the shoulders and upper arms. The drawing is rendered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Girl's Coat
